Hi Emily — great to see the forecast, thanks for sharing. We can do what you describe with a few clarifications and one alternate structure to consider that customers find operationally simpler.

Quick answers:
- Voucher mechanics: vouchers are non-refundable credits that can be applied to hosted API usage invoices. If you convert to a committed plan during the pilot, unused voucher balance can be applied as a conversion credit per your proposal.
- PO terms: we support net-30 for pilots; enterprise contracts default to net-45 but can be negotiated.
- Flexibility: we can upsize the pilot voucher after month 1 if signal (call rates, token consumption, accuracy) meets agreed checkpoints.

Alternate (recommended) approach:
- Starter Voucher Pack: 100k gen tokens + 300k embedding tokens for 90 days. This reduces admin overhead and gives your engineers more headroom for evals.
- Commit ramp schedule: if you sign a 12-month commit within the 90-day window, we propose a graduated discount program tied to committed monthly average throughput:
  * Commit A: 500k tokens/mo -> 7% off list per-token
  * Commit B: 2M tokens/mo -> 11% off
  * Commit C: 5M+ tokens/mo -> 16% off + 10k onboarding credit applied after month 1
- Conversion credit: unused voucher portion applied against the first invoice after conversion.

I'll loop in Marissa (commercial) and Karthik (pricing ops) — Marissa can lay out the three formal options and Karthik can confirm billing and invoice flow. Attached: a short SOW template I started (NovaScale_SOW_Draft.pdf).

Hi Emily — thanks for the clarity. Below are three commercial packages we commonly offer; pick the one that best matches your procurement appetite.

Option 1 — Light Pilot (fast, minimal commitment)- Starter Voucher Pack: 100k gen / 300k embed (90 days)- No upfront fees; usage billed at list per-token beyond voucher- No SLA; conversion possible with credit for unused voucher

Option 2 — Pilot + Convert (balanced)- Starter Voucher Pack: 100k gen / 300k embed (90 days)- If converted to a 12-mo commit within 90 days: one-time conversion credit equal to unused voucher value + 10% discount for first 3 billing cycles- Net-30 PO accepted

Option 3 — Commit Ramp (higher commitment, lower unit cost)- 12-mo commit tiers (500k / 2M / 5M tokens/mo) with stepped discounts (7% / 11% / 16%)- 30k onboarding credit if you sign within the pilot window; committed spend counts toward marketplace rebates where applicable- SLA (99.9%) and priority support included

Notes on slabs: the slab thresholds are negotiable for enterprise contracts but the percentage deltas reflect our current pricing grid and amortized infra cost. Marissa
